current.pipeline: physical payload gravity plus learned residual

legacy.pipeline: stored V7 residual after 80 Hz prediction LPF and startup residual bias

conclusion: typical error improved; hard maximum regressed; no single winner

evaluation_contract.comparison_scope: deployed runtime residual pipelines, not isolated predictors
evaluation_contract.metric: Euclidean force residual norm in N
evaluation_contract.shared_mask: official interval AND stored valid/model_ready AND current 32-sample warmup AND guarded legacy FREE

limitations: the legacy observer contact state defines FREE and can selection-bias the comparison toward V7
the models predict different sensor targets and frames
56 current-model episodes use 30 Hz joint interpolation
one observer log lacks embedded metadata and cannot independently prove its V7 contract
no independent same-clock contact ground truth is available
